remarks: FOR RENT - This cozy and fully renovated three-bedroom house is tucked away on a peaceful cul-de-sac, just a short walk from the Cos Cob train station, shops, and a lovely park. In 2023, this home got a complete makeover, with new flooring, a modern kitchen, updated bathrooms, a brand-new roof, and a fresh driveway. The open living space is perfect for hanging out or hosting guests, featuring a sleek kitchen with Quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a cool basketweave tile floor. The dining and living areas are bright and spacious, with a large picture window that brings in lots of natural light and a door that leads right out to your private backyard. You'll find three comfy bedrooms here, along with a full bathroom and a convenient half bath. There's also a mudroom and a laundry room with easy access to the backyard. The one-car garage is attached, so you'll never have to worry about parking. We've also added some thoughtful touches like custom closets, a wider driveway, and irrigation systems to make your life easier. If you're looking for a comfortable and stylish place to rent in a great location, this could be the perfect fit for you!
